2609.24101.title: When More Evidence Hurts: Publication-Bias Drift and Principled Stopping for Biomedical Causal Search
2609.24101.paper_summary: Automated biomedical evidence synthesis depends on retrieving published studies, but the biomedical literature is systematically skewed toward positive findings. Deeper retrieval can therefore make a system \emph{more} likely to falsely infer benefit when the true effect is null. We formalise this phenomenon as \emph{evidence drift} and prove that, under a standard publication-bias model, the false-positive probability on null-effect queries follows a strictly increasing large-sample envelope in retrieval depth, approaching one. Empirically, on a held-out test set of 140 Cochrane-derived queries, drift rises monotonically from 7.9\% to 15.7\% as the retrieval budget grows from 3 to 20 steps, and concentrates in the null-effect class. We present DACG-agent, a drift-aware causal-graph agent that incrementally builds a causal knowledge graph from PubMed abstracts and applies a two-layer stopping policy with complementary roles: a KL-divergence monitor that detects posterior convergence (the accuracy layer), and a Bradley--Terry process reward model (PRM) whose online decline detection halts retrieval once evidence quality peaks (the efficiency layer). Against full-budget retrieval, DACG-agent reduces evidence drift from 15.7\% to 6.4\% and improves null-effect accuracy by 21 percentage points (40.0\%$\to$61.4\%) while using 67\% fewer retrieval steps; overall accuracy rises from 61.4\% to 69.3\% (95\% CI 61--77). A simulation confirms the drift result transfers from the analysed vote-counting aggregator to the deployed noisy-OR one.
2609.24101.paper_summary_zh: 自動化生物醫學證據綜合依賴於檢索已發表的研究，但生物醫學文獻系統性地偏向於正面發現。更深入的檢索因此可能使系統\emph{更}有可能在真實效果為零的情況下錯誤推斷出好處。我們將這一現象形式化為\emph{證據漂移}，並證明在標準的出版偏見模型下，對於零效果查詢的假陽性概率隨著檢索深度的增加而嚴格上升，並趨近於一。在一組140個Cochrane衍生查詢的保留測試集上，漂移隨著檢索預算從3步增長到20步而單調上升，從7.9\%增至15.7\%，並集中在零效果類別。我們提出了DACG-agent，一種考慮漂移的因果圖代理，該代理從PubMed摘要中逐步構建因果知識圖，並應用具有互補角色的兩層停止政策：一個KL散度監控器檢測後驗收斂（準確性層），以及一個Bradley--Terry過程獎勵模型（PRM），其在線下降檢測在證據質量達到峰值時停止檢索（效率層）。與全預算檢索相比，DACG-agent將證據漂移從15.7\%降低至6.4\%，並將零效果準確性提高21個百分點（40.0\%$\to$61.4\%），同時使用67\%更少的檢索步驟；整體準確性從61.4\%上升至69.3\%（95\% CI 61--77）。模擬確認了漂移結果從分析的投票計數聚合器轉移到部署的噪聲OR聚合器。
